metaDescription: ShuleOS, the trusted digital director for school founders in the DRC. Protect your legacy, secure your finances, lead with peace of mind — no technical skill required.

legal.privacyDescription: How {productName} collects, uses, and protects your school's data.
legal.termsDescription: The agreement between your school and {productName} when using our platform.
legal.cookiesDescription: How {productName} uses cookies and similar technologies on our website.
legal.privacyP1: {legalName} ("Digni Digital", "{productName}", "we", "us") provides a school management platform for administrators, teachers, parents, and students. We are headquartered in {office}. This Privacy Policy explains how we handle personal information when you use our website and services.
legal.privacyAccountBody: name, email address, role, and school affiliation when you register or are invited.
legal.privacySchoolBody: student records, attendance, grades, fees, timetables, and other information your school uploads to the platform.
legal.privacyUsageBody: log data, device type, browser, IP address, and pages visited to improve security and performance.
legal.privacyCommsBody: messages sent through {productName} and support enquiries you submit to us.
legal.privacyUse1: Provide, operate, and maintain the {productName} platform
legal.privacyUse2: Authenticate users and enforce role-based access
legal.privacyUse3: Process school workflows such as admissions, fees, and reporting
legal.privacyUse4: Send service notifications, security alerts, and support responses
legal.privacyUse5: Comply with legal obligations and prevent fraud or abuse
legal.privacyP4: We do not sell personal data. We may share information with trusted subprocessors (such as hosting and email providers) under strict data processing agreements, or when required by law.
legal.privacyP5: Data is retained for as long as your school's account is active or as needed to meet legal requirements. We apply encryption in transit, access controls, and audit logging to protect your information.
legal.privacyP6: Depending on your jurisdiction, you may request access, correction, export, or deletion of your personal data. School administrators can manage most user records directly; individual requests can be sent to {email}.
legal.termsP1: By creating an account, accessing {productName}, or using any part of the service, you agree to these Terms of Service on behalf of yourself and your school. If you do not agree, do not use the platform.
legal.termsP2: {productName} provides cloud-based tools for academic management, finance, staff operations, parent communication, analytics, and school websites. Features may change as we improve the product.
legal.termsLi1: School administrators are responsible for user invitations and permissions.
legal.termsLi2: Users must keep login credentials confidential.
legal.termsLi3: You are responsible for the accuracy of data entered into {productName}.
legal.termsLi4: You must not misuse the platform, attempt unauthorized access, or violate applicable laws.
legal.termsP4: Your school retains ownership of the data you upload. {productName} processes that data solely to provide the service. Upon termination, export options will be made available subject to your plan and applicable law.
legal.termsP5: Paid plans, if applicable, are billed according to the pricing agreed at signup. Failure to pay may result in suspension after reasonable notice. Taxes and payment processor fees may apply.
legal.termsP6: We aim for high availability but do not guarantee uninterrupted service. Scheduled maintenance and force majeure events may cause temporary downtime. Support is provided via documentation and email during business hours.
legal.termsP7: To the maximum extent permitted by law, {productName} is not liable for indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from use of the service. Our total liability is limited to fees paid in the twelve months preceding the claim.
legal.termsP8: Either party may terminate with written notice. We may suspend access immediately for security risks or material breach. Sections on data, liability, and governing law survive termination.
legal.termsP9: These terms are governed by the laws of the Democratic Republic of the Congo. Any disputes shall be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts of {city}.
legal.cookiesP1: Cookies are small text files stored on your device when you visit a website. They help us keep you signed in, remember preferences, and understand how the site is used.
legal.cookiesEssentialBody: required for authentication, session management, and security. The platform cannot function without these.
legal.cookiesPreferenceBody: remember settings such as theme or language where supported.
legal.cookiesAnalyticsBody: help us measure usage and improve performance. These are only set where consent or legitimate interest applies.
legal.cookiesP3: Some integrated services (such as authentication or error monitoring) may set their own cookies. We review subprocessors for compliance with our privacy standards.
legal.cookiesP4: You can control cookies through your browser settings. Disabling essential cookies may prevent you from logging in or using core {productName} features.
legal.cookiesP5: We may update this policy as our technology changes. Material updates will be reflected on this page with a revised "Last updated" date.
